target.title: test(qa): guard unsupported Crabline channels
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QA runtime currently relies on Crabline channel selection validation from the underlying resolver, but `extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.runtime.test.ts` did not lock that contract with an explicit regression test. That makes it easy for a future refactor to silently widen or change unsupported `--channel-driver crabline --channel ...` behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR keeps the QA test surface aligned with the actual installed Crabline contract instead of asserting unsupported channels that the dependency does not accept. After review, the incorrect rejection table was removed and the evidence was refreshed from the real package in this checkout.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. This only keeps QA regression coverage and PR evidence aligned with the current Crabline validation behavior.

## Evidence

### Real runtime contract proof

The installed `crabline` package in this checkout currently resolves only `telegram` and rejects the other probed channels:

```bash
$ node --input-type=module - <<'EOF'
const crabline = await import(new URL('./node_modules/crabline/dist/src/index.js', import.meta.url));
const fn = crabline.resolveOpenClawCrablineChannelDriverSelection;
const channels = ['signal','mattermost','matrix','slack','whatsapp','telegram','not-a-real-channel'];
for (const channel of channels) {
  try {
    const selection = fn({ channel });
    console.log(channel, 'OK', JSON.stringify(selection));
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(channel, 'ERR', err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
  }
}
EOF
signal ERR --channel must be one of telegram for --channel-driver crabline, got "signal".
mattermost ERR --channel must be one of telegram for --channel-driver crabline, got "mattermost".
matrix ERR --channel must be one of telegram for --channel-driver crabline, got "matrix".
slack ERR --channel must be one of telegram for --channel-driver crabline, got "slack".
whatsapp ERR --channel must be one of telegram for --channel-driver crabline, got "whatsapp".
telegram OK {"channel":"telegram","channelDriver":"crabline","capabilityMatrixPath":"crabline-fake-provider-capabilities.json","smokeArtifactPath":"crabline-fake-provider-smoke.json"}
not-a-real-channel ERR --channel must be one of telegram for --channel-driver crabline, got "not-a-real-channel".
```

### Focused test run

```bash
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.runtime.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-qa.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8 /home/0668000995/10288592/git-hub/test/openclaw

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  83 passed (83)
   Start at  22:44:48
   Duration  13.66s (transform 3.65s, setup 577ms, import 6.36s, tests 6.43s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 23.83s
```

### Net effect after review correction

- Dropped the contradicted rejection table from `extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.runtime.test.ts`
- Kept the PR aligned with the real installed dependency behavior instead of codifying a false unsupported-channel contract
